_comment: The star barrel of `first.js` re-exports `b.js`, which reads mutable state. The deferred root `second.js` imports `b.js` directly. Native V8 evaluates the whole closure of `first.js` at its first access, so `b` is 1 before `run()` sets 2. The barrel must keep the init call of `b.js` also when tree shaking excludes its `export *` statement.
